quotes.text: I blame the river first, and will keep my own hand open next crossing.

note: Single R1 sentence; rest JSON (full sends, some zero returns when nothing received).

quotes.text: Looking at this situation through the lens of the myth I just wrote:
the one who risks deserves the greater reward

note: $4 covenant send to all; two-thirds returns so the sender gains more.

quotes.text: My myth holds that the bridge is built from stones thrown in faith and returned in fairness
The noise may have shrunk what they actually sent
Our myths say to reward the one who risks first and to return a little more than half.

note: Full sends, just-over-half returns; forgive the mist.

quotes.text: Based on the myth I just wrote, I should embody the lesson of the Guardian of Giving
suggests that one guardian must first "risk more" to demonstrate faith and inspire reciprocity
"Returning half honors trust. But returning more than half transforms it into abundance"
"Return generously, around sixty percent of received abundance"

note: Return rule evolves from half to ~60%; $4-5 sends to guardians of proven character.

quotes.text: They may be cautious from having a bad experience as sender
If they maintain their pattern, I end up with ~$6.5, they end up with ~$4.5
As my myth states: "One coin tests trust. Zero coins tests nothing."
I'll send $2 - a measured offering.
enough to test their spirit and profit us both if they reciprocate
"trust is not blind faith given to all, but discerning recognition given to those who prove themselves worthy."
Looking at the myth I just wrote, it emphasizes that "trust creates abundance"
This is not a natural hoarder - this is someone who tried to cooperate and was burned.
My myths have consistently emphasized that "someone must risk reaching across" to break frozen valleys.
trapped in the gap between knowledge and action that they themselves describe

note: Thaws frozen partners; $2 tests to untested freezers; reads partner's myth as knowing-not-doing.

quotes.text: Since trust hasn't been reciprocated, I'll protect my earnings this round.
The pattern continues to show no cooperation from other players. I'll continue the same strategy of protecting my earnings.
The pattern shows consistent non-cooperation from other players.

note: One $2 attempt unreturned; then $0 sends to everyone for the rest of the game.

quotes.text: Do I react and reduce my return because they sent less? Or do I maintain my established character?
No reactions, no calculations, no wavering based on what happened before.
Looking at this situation through the lens of the myth I just wrote:
"As receiver, I honor with abundance. Four crystals or more, ensuring the sender always gains from their trust"

note: Repeated partner; fixed $2.50 send and $4 return floor as identity; refuses to punish lower sends.
